source.check: Contests from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8; unopposed returns from the News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7, and the Irish News of the same date.

note: Triennial election for the 21 seats, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Eleven divisions were contested and ten were filled unopposed. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Checked on the page images of the Irish News, 17 May 1967, p. 8 and the Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1967, p. 7 (w8-review, Nov 2026): the Irish News names him Mr. Frank Corey, 'the first National Democratic Party member to be returned unopposed', so his party is now the National Democratic Party (was blank); the News-Letter's 'Frances Corey' is a misprint.
